email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Maya, saw dbt Labs merged with Fivetran and just took Snowflake's 2026 Data Integration Partner of the Year.

A combined motion that big usually means more accounts in play than the customer-sales team can cover before the orgs fully knit together, and that is where expansion deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Maya, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Mid-merger, quota coverage usually gets fuzzy fast: the combined account base grows quicker than reps can touch it, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to hit target this quarter, and where coverage breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Maya, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data-infra companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Maya, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling customer pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-merger is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your expansion motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
